description: Enhance the tentang-manulife.html and tentang-manulife-syariah.html pages with more comprehensive content about Manulife Indonesia and Manulife Syariah respectively
steps: In public/pages/tentang-manulife.html, expand the existing content by adding new sections after the existing ones. Add: (1) a 'Nilai-Nilai Perusahaan' (Corporate Values) section with cards for Obsesi Pelanggan, Bertindak Benar, Berpikir Besar, Menghargai Keragaman, Berbagi Keahlian, and Akuntabilitas; (2) a 'Produk & Layanan Unggulan' section covering categories like Asuransi Jiwa, Asuransi Kesehatan, Dana Pensiun, Investasi/Reksadana, Asuransi Syariah, and Program Employee Benefits; (3) a 'Kepemimpinan & Tata Kelola' section describing the strong corporate governance, Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and DPS (for syariah); (4) a 'Teknologi & Inovasi Digital' section about MiAccount app, online claims, telemedicine partnerships, digital onboarding. Follow the existing card/grid patterns already in the page.

In public/pages/tentang-manulife-syariah.html, expand with additional content sections: (1) 'Sejarah Manulife Syariah di Indonesia' section with timeline of key Sharia milestones (2009 first syariah product, DSN-MUI approvals, growth milestones); (2) 'Dewan Pengawas Syariah (DPS)' section explaining the role of DPS, their oversight function, and how they ensure all products comply with Islamic principles; (3) 'Fatwa & Regulasi' section listing key DSN-MUI fatwas that govern their products (Fatwa No. 21, 51, 52, 53); (4) 'Testimoni & Kasus Klaim Syariah' section with example scenarios showing how ta'awun works in practice; (5) 'FAQ Asuransi Syariah' section with expandable Q&A covering common questions like 'Apa bedanya dengan asuransi konvensional?', 'Bagaimana surplus underwriting dihitung?', etc. Follow existing page patterns (section-tag, section-title, card grids, fade-up animations).
acceptance_criteria: tentang-manulife.html contains new sections for Corporate Values, Products & Services, Leadership, and Technology
tentang-manulife-syariah.html contains new sections for Sharia History timeline, DPS, Fatwa & Regulasi, Testimoni, and FAQ
New sections follow the same HTML/CSS patterns as existing sections in those pages (section-tag, section-title, card grids, fade-up classes)
All new content is in Indonesian language (Bahasa Indonesia)
No broken HTML structure - pages remain valid HTML5

Run: grep -c 'Sejarah.*Syariah\|Dewan Pengawas\|Fatwa.*Regulasi\|FAQ' /projects/sandbox/Project-Cuan-3.0/public/pages/tentang-manulife-syariah.html -- should return at least 4 matches
Verify HTML validity: grep -c '</html>' both files should return 1 each (proper closing)
